simple.meaning: אָמִיר (ʼâmîyr) is a Hebrew word meaning “a summit (of a tree or mountain).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אָמִיר (H534) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 17:6, with occurrences in Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אָמִיר (H534) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אָמִיר (H534) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אָמִיר (ʼâmîyr) / H534 is traced through Isaiah 17:6, Isaiah 17:9 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: a summit (of a tree or mountain)
definitions.full: H534. amir אָמִיר noun masculine top, summit, of tree Isa 17:6 ; of mountain 17:9 (? So Ew Kn De Di; Lag Che Brd Or following ᵐ5 & read הָאֱמֹרִי ); plural construct אֲמִרֵי Gen 49:21 (so read for אִמְרֵי , Ew Di and others, compare also 1. אֵלָה p.18).
definitions.rootNote: apparently from 559 (in the sense of self-exaltation );

occurrences.englishText: Yet gleanings will be left there, like the shaking of an olive tree, two or three olives in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outermost branches of a fruitful tree,” says Yahweh, the God of Israel.
In that day, their strong cities will be like the forsaken places in the woods and on the mountain top, which were forsaken from before the children of Israel; and it will be a desolation.
